# SPACE INVADERS (requires 2K) - Fred Lever (Jnr) - DREAMER 9 pp.20-21 (PDF pages 22-23)
# CHIP-8 0200-04FF + data 0500-05FF (letter table at 0558 in CHIPOS 3x5 hex-pattern format, read
# by the 6800 routine at 02BA: LDAA V0 / LDX #$0556 / JSR $C198; 02C3: LDX #$0100 / LDAA #$FF /
# JSR $C07D = fill screen). Load 0200-05FF, run C000, needs 2K RAM.
# Intro: "SPACE INVADERS" (misspelt, then fixed by an invader); key 1 = start the game.
# Keys: C = left, D = right (the article; the listing at 0386 reads 660E, so right is key E),
# F = fire. Four bomb hits or invaders reaching the right of the screen = game over;
# "DANGER" when they come close. Winning gives a free game.
